# Rodentia
Rodentia are a race of humanoid beings resembling rodents. Resourceful, evasive, sneaky, but fragile.
## Background
Long before Solarian humans dared test on their own kind, they refined their ambitions on yours. You were rats in sterile cages, with quick hearts mapped and measured. Your generations were documented then discarded. You were never meant to take on their world… only to help them survive it. But somewhere between error, observation and injections, something changed. The line between your minds and theirs began to blur.
At first, the changes were subtle: upright posture. Dexterous hands. Eyes that lingered too long on reflections. Researchers called it “adaptive drift,” then “emergent cognition,” and finally stopped naming it at all when your kind began to speak. It began first in mimicry, then in meaning. Neural implants meant to monitor you instead modified you. Genetic edits meant to stabilize you instead awakened something latent. You were no longer just responding, you were thinking.
You are no longer rodents, but Rodentia. Some are from lineages: two altered rodentia raising litters in new planets they were freed to. Others remember the experiments. A few speak of anomalies: flashes of impossible light, moments where something new took its place. There is no single origin planet or expected roots, for every Rodentia is from a different place.
## Unique Abilities
### Rummaging
- Rodentia can rummage in disposal chutes, which can sometimes [color=#1e90ff]dig up food.[/color] Yum!
### Rodent Storage
- Rodentia can store small items in their cheeks. Having items in their mouth makes their speech unintelligible, and they will drop all items in their mouth if attacked, stunned, or shoved.
### Sneaking
- Due to their small stature and rodent instincts, Rodentia can [color=#1e90ff]sneak underneath tables.[/color] However, they are unable to sneak under doors.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat. - Will get [color=#FFA500]poisoned[/color] by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- They can use their claws to do some [color=#ec3a3a]Slashing[/color] and [color=#ec3a3a]Blunt[/color] damage. - They can fit in duffelbags.
## Drawbacks
- Takes [color=#FFA500]15% more Blunt, Slash, and Piercing damage.[/color] - Always triggers mousetraps, regardless of whether or not they are wearing shoes. - Gets [color=#FFA500]hungry 33% faster.[/color]
